subject: Duplicate PO consolidation and request for monthly statement / invoice cadence
messages:
From: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acmecorp.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Question: Can you consolidate duplicate POs into a monthly statement?

Hi Rachel,

Quick procurement question as we finish vendor setup for the Redwood contract (D-87214). Our ERP is fairly rigid and it flags multiple invoices that reference the same underlying SOW unless they're delivered as a single monthly statement that lists all related PO numbers. 

We currently have two POs for Redwood services (PO# ACME-3382 and ACME-3382-1) due to an internal splitting of billing entities. Can your billing team: 
- Produce a single consolidated monthly statement that references both PO numbers on one PDF?
- Support our standard net30 terms and a separate monthly statement file (rather than many individual PDFs)?

If you can, please share a typical consolidated invoice template and confirm what data needs to flow in the invoice (PO reference, Redwood invoice ID, custom accounting tags). We need this to avoid holds during vendor onboarding.

Appreciate the quick help — our vendor onboarding deadline is next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Chang
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
attachments: none

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acmecorp.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: Can you consolidate duplicate POs into a monthly statement?

Hi Lisa — thanks for flagging this. Short answer: yes, we can support a consolidated monthly statement that lists multiple PO numbers, and we can invoice on net30. A couple of operational clarifications so we can match your ERP fields: 

1) Invoice content: we can include multiple PO lines and a top-level "Related PO numbers" field. We will also include the Redwood invoice number, invoice date, bill-to and remit-to details, and one summary amount per PO.

2) File format: PDF is our standard; we can also provide a CSV/ XLSX export if your ERP prefers structured import.

3) Cutoff and cadence: We propose generating a consolidated statement on the 1st business day of every month that aggregates activity from the prior calendar month. If you prefer a different cutoff (e.g., 25th -> 24th monthly window), we can adapt.

Attached: sample_consolidated_invoice_template.xlsx (example layout) and po-consolidation-matrix.csv (how we'd map multiple PO numbers). 

Ben, can you confirm whether Finance is comfortable accepting a single consolidated PDF that references multiple PO numbers for payment processing and whether we need an AR memo in the file for reconciliation?

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: sample_consolidated_invoice_template.xlsx, po-consolidation-matrix.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acmecorp.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: Can you consolidate duplicate POs into a monthly statement?

Thanks for the context, Rachel / Lisa. Finance is generally OK with consolidated monthly statements that reference multiple PO numbers, provided: 
- Each PO reference is visible and the invoice line items map cleanly to each PO (we need PO number -> invoice line grouping).
- The statement aggregates to a single "Amount Due" and includes a per-PO breakdown for reconciliation.
- For large accounts we include an AR note section listing internal charge codes if required.

One ask from our side: can you confirm whether Acme needs the statement to include individual invoice numbers for each PO (i.e., one invoice per PO that we then bundle into a single statement) or whether a single statement with per-PO line items is sufficient.

If a single statement with per-PO items works, we won't create multiple invoices (helps prevent duplicates internally). If Acme requires individual invoice numbers per PO for their AP system, we can issue invoice stubs (Invoice #s) and still produce the consolidated statement as a cover page. 

Grace — FYI, this may require a small AR workflow change for the first-month onboarding (invoice stubs vs no stubs). Do you prefer we create stub numbers so Acme's ERP has distinct invoice ids to match?

Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-05-31T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: Can you consolidate duplicate POs into a monthly statement?

Thanks Ben — good question. Our AP system requires an invoice identifier per PO for automated matching in most cases. For this account we can accept either of the two options below: 

Option A (preferred): Redwood issues discrete invoice numbers for each PO (Invoice ACME-202705-01 -> maps to PO ACME-3382; Invoice ACME-202705-02 -> maps to PO ACME-3382-1) and then Redwood provides a consolidated monthly statement (PDF) that lists both invoice numbers and shows the net total. This preserves our matching logic and keeps the monthly statement as a single artifact for approvals.

Option B (alternate): Redwood issues a single consolidated invoice number referencing both PO numbers and includes per-PO line detail. This will require a manual exception in our ERP for automated matching, so we'd prefer Option A.

We also confirm net30 and the 1st-business-day statement cadence works for us.

If you can send Option A as an example (two invoice numbers + consolidated statement cover page) we'll route to AP and finish onboarding.

Best,
Lisa

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: Can you consolidate duplicate POs into a monthly statement?

Hi all — Grace from Finance. We can support Option A (issue per-PO invoice numbers and produce a consolidated monthly statement as a cover). Operational notes and next steps: 

1) We'll produce Invoice IDs per PO (format: RWI-YYYYMM-####).
2) The consolidated statement PDF will be the deliverable Acme's approvers see; it will list the invoice IDs and a per-PO breakdown.
3) We'll include an AR memo block with Redwood accounting codes; if Acme can provide their internal charge codes per PO in the onboarding packet we will add them to the CSV export for ERP import.

Action items: 
- Rachel: send a sample for Option A (two invoice stubs + consolidated cover) — Ben has the template Rachel attached earlier; please make a draft for June so Acme can approve before onboarding.
- Ben/Finance: create a vendor onboarding ticket (BILL-4591) with required fields and note net30.
- Lisa: confirm any required internal charge codes for PO ACME-3382 & ACME-3382-1 and we'll include them in the CSV.

We'll produce the first consolidated statement during the first week of June (covering May activity) once we have the charge codes.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Revenue Operations & Finance Systems
Redwood Inference
attachments: none
